references.text: Rules about uncleanness from touching dead bodies, which provide the background for the priests' special restrictions regarding contact with the dead.
The Nazirites' prohibition against becoming unclean from the dead, even close family members, parallel to the priests' restrictions.
Ezekiel's prophecy concerning the priests' rules about uncleanness from the dead in the future temple.
Aaron and his sons were forbidden to mourn over Nadab and Abihu in the usual way because of their holy service.
The institution of Aaron and his sons as priests, the basis for the special rules for the priesthood.
Stricter rules for the high priest regarding uncleanness from the dead; he could not even become unclean for his closest relatives.
